messages.subject: lmList question
parts:
Dear all,

I am using the ggplot2 and have two linear regression line in a plot.

I use lmList to get both the regression line equations coefficients,
Code: myEq <-lmList( y~x | factor(group), myData, na.action=na.omit)

How do I calculate R.squared for each one of them & how can I extract
the data for each equation in the form of "y=ax+b, r2"?

Thanks.

messages.subject: Re: lmList question
parts:
I did some extraction of lm information for plotting stuff ages ago with the help of this list... maybe even Dennis (you da man). 

I make an lm and then extract the r-squared values from the summary... 

Hope you can make it out, but Dennis is right if you posted an example it's easier to help. 

Brandon

#Code Starts

m <- lm(WIBI_5d ~ WIBI_11d, data = lm.data)
p <- ggplot(lm.data, aes(x = WIBI_5d, y = WIBI_11d)) + 
geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
geom_point()

eq <- substitute(italic(y) == a + b %.% italic(x)*","~~italic(r)^2~"="~r2,

list(
a = format(coef(m)[1], digits = 4),
b = format(coef(m)[2], digits = 4),
r2 = format(summary(m)$r.squared, digits = 3)))

dftext <- data.frame(eq = as.character(as.expression(eq)))

p<-p + geom_text(aes(label = eq, x=5, y=2), data = dftext, parse = TRUE)
